name: devlab
description: Dev Lab — laboratórios guiados ServiceNow (Hub + Agent). Node só para compilar localmente e gerar os Update Sets XML.

scripts.hub:build: npm --prefix hub run clean && npm --prefix hub run build
scripts.agent:build: npm --prefix agent run clean && npm --prefix agent run build
scripts.updateset:prova: npm run hub:build && node scripts/build-updateset.js hub --profile prova
scripts.updateset:hub: npm run hub:build && node scripts/build-updateset.js hub
scripts.updateset:agent: npm run agent:build && node scripts/build-updateset.js agent
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm test && npm run hub:build && npm run agent:build
